title: Meetings
description: The cooperative's assemblies and committee meetings, with their agendas, attendance, decisions and minutes.

statusMeaning.IN_PROGRESS: Under way. The agenda, attendance and decisions can still be recorded.
statusMeaning.COMPLETED: Closed. The record stands; only the follow-up on actions can still change.
statusMeaning.CANCELLED: Called off. The reason is part of the record.

list.caption: Meetings, most recent first
list.emptyTitle: No meeting has been recorded yet
list.emptyBody: Schedule the next assembly and its agenda, then take attendance against the register on the day.

form.quorumHint: Leave this empty if the cooperative's own rules set no quorum.

detail.loadFailed: This meeting could not be loaded.
detail.quorumNone: No quorum is set for this meeting
detail.quorumWarning: Fewer members are present than the quorum this meeting needs, so it cannot decide anything. Record it as it stands.
detail.closedNotice: This meeting is closed. Its agenda, attendance and decisions are now the record and cannot be changed; an action can still be marked done.
detail.documentsEmpty: No paper has been filed against this meeting.
detail.minutesNone: The minutes have not been filed yet.

agendaForm.title: Set the agenda
agendaForm.description: The order here is the order the meeting will take. Items are numbered when you save.
agendaForm.empty: No items yet. Add the first one.

attendanceForm.title: Take attendance
attendanceForm.description: Attendance is taken against the register, which is what makes the quorum provable.

decisionForm.title: Record a decision
decisionForm.description: What a meeting resolved and how it voted cannot be edited afterwards, so check it before saving.
decisionForm.titlePlaceholder: Buy a second maize dryer before the next harvest
decisionForm.votesHint: Leave these empty if no vote was taken.

cancelDialog.title: Call off this meeting?
cancelDialog.body: The meeting stays in the record with the reason you give, because a cooperative's minute book has no missing numbers.
cancelDialog.reasonPlaceholder: Postponed: the district officer could not attend

completeDialog.title: Close this meeting?
completeDialog.body: Once closed, the agenda, the attendance and the decisions are the record and cannot be changed. An action can still be marked done afterwards.

minutesDialog.title: Attach the minutes
minutesDialog.body: Choose a document already filed for this cooperative. Upload it first if it is not there yet.
minutesDialog.noDocuments: No document is available to attach.
